name: Declared Evidence Check-Consistency (evidence-check-consistency)
description: C02 cross-record demo: the declared `evidence-check-consistency` route runs `evidence check-consistency` as one attempt — identical pins report `consistent: true` with `conflict_count: 0`; a record disagreeing on a shared identity pin reports `consistent: false` with named conflicts. Both outcomes select the diagnostic — the check completed either way. A gated `--expected-adapter` run names declared_producer_identity, and a mismatched adapter claims nothing.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: C02 cross-record demo: the declared `evidence-check-consistency` route runs `evidence check-consistency` as one attempt — identical pins report `consistent: true` with `conflict_count: 0`; a record disagreeing on a shared identity pin reports `consistent: false` with named conflicts. Both outcomes select the diagnostic — the check completed either way. A gated `--expected-adapter` run names declared_producer_identity, and a mismatched adapter claims nothing.
success_criteria: consistent_report.json carries consistent == True, conflict_count == 0 and a candidate
conflict_report.json carries consistent == False, conflict_count >= 1 naming field subject.kind, and still a candidate (the check completed)
gated_report.json names declared_producer_identity alongside cross_record_pin_agreement in checks_performed
gated_mismatch_report.json carries no checks_performed, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C02 cross-record consistency check: mint a real record, wrap two identical copies in the list envelope and assert consistent, then tamper one copy's subject.kind pin and assert consistent false with a named conflict — the diagnostic selects either way because the check itself completed. A gated run with --expected-adapter mumei.source-evidence then names declared_producer_identity, and a mismatched adapter is rejected with no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/evidence_check_consistency/src/identity.mm and envelopes of identical-vs-tampered record pairs.
Step 3 asserts consistent true with zero conflicts; step 4 asserts consistent false with a subject.kind conflict — both select the diagnostic.
The gated step asserts checks_performed names declared_producer_identity on a matching declared producer.
The mismatch step feeding a wrong adapter produces no claimed outcome.

steps.name: Mint a real Evidence record via verify-source
steps.verifier_gate: evidence verify-source exits 0 with a JSON record.

steps.name: Wrap identical and tampered pairs
steps.command: python3 -c "import json, copy; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/evidence.json')); env={'schema_version':'mumei.verification-evidence-list/v1','evidence':[r,r]}; json.dump(env, open('{output_dir}/same.json','w')); t=copy.deepcopy(r); t['subject']['kind']='foreign_source'; env2={'schema_version':'mumei.verification-evidence-list/v1','evidence':[r,t]}; json.dump(env2, open('{output_dir}/conflict.json','w')); print('envelopes: same-pair + conflict-pair')" && cat {output_dir}/same.json && cat {output_dir}/conflict.json
steps.artifact_contract: same.json holds identical copies; conflict.json holds a copy disagreeing on subject.kind (a second valid enum value).
steps.verifier_gate: Both envelopes carry the declared schema_version.

steps.name: Identical pins report consistent
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-consistency --core {mumei_bin} --evidence {output_dir}/same.json --output {output_dir}/consistent_report.json > {output_dir}/consistent.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/consistent_report.json; cat {output_dir}/consistent.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/consistent_report.json')); assert r['consistent'] is True, r; assert r['conflict_count']==0, r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None, r; assert r['candidate']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1'; print('consistent pair: consistent, 0 conflicts')"
steps.artifact_contract: consistent_report.json holds consistent true, conflict_count 0 and a candidate.
steps.verifier_gate: Identical pins exit 0 with the consistent diagnostic.

steps.name: Shared-pin disagreement reports inconsistent
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-consistency --core {mumei_bin} --evidence {output_dir}/conflict.json --output {output_dir}/conflict_report.json > {output_dir}/conflict.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/conflict_report.json; cat {output_dir}/conflict.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/conflict_report.json')); assert r['consistent'] is False, r; assert r['conflict_count']>=1, r; assert any(c['field']=='subject.kind' for c in r['conflicts']), r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None, r; assert r['candidate']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1'; print('conflict pair: inconsistent, subject.kind conflict named')"
steps.artifact_contract: conflict_report.json holds consistent false, a subject.kind conflict and still a candidate.
steps.verifier_gate: The disagreement is reported as a named conflict — the check completed, so the diagnostic selects.

steps.name: evidence-check-consistency: --expected-adapter gate reports declared_producer_identity
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-consistency --core {mumei_bin} --evidence {output_dir}/same.json --expected-adapter mumei.source-evidence --output {output_dir}/gated_report.json > {output_dir}/gated.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/gated_report.json; cat {output_dir}/gated.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/gated_report.json')); assert r['checks_performed']==['representation_gate','cross_record_pin_agreement','declared_producer_identity'], r['checks_performed']; assert 'producer_authenticity' in r['checks_not_performed'], r['checks_not_performed']; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert r['consistent'] is True; print('evidence-check-consistency: gated run names declared_producer_identity')"
steps.artifact_contract: gated_report.json binds the gated diagnostic: checks_performed ["representation_gate", "cross_record_pin_agreement", "declared_producer_identity"] while producer_authenticity stays in checks_not_performed.
steps.verifier_gate: evidence-check-consistency --expected-adapter mumei.source-evidence exits 0; the gated diagnostic names declared_producer_identity.

steps.name: evidence-check-consistency: mismatched expected adapter claims nothing
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-consistency --core {mumei_bin} --evidence {output_dir}/same.json --expected-adapter other-adapter --output {output_dir}/gated_mismatch_report.json > {output_dir}/gated_mismatch.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/gated_mismatch_report.json; cat {output_dir}/gated_mismatch.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/gated_mismatch_report.json')); assert 'checks_performed' not in r, r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None, r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code')==1, r['normalized']; print('evidence-check-consistency: mismatched adapter exits 1, no claim')"
steps.artifact_contract: gated_mismatch_report.json carries the report schema with no checks_performed, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1 — a declared producer mismatch binds nothing.
steps.verifier_gate: evidence-check-consistency --expected-adapter other-adapter: Core's gate rejects the record and the route claims no outcome.
